summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, Krebs on Security, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
